title: Comparison refuses a paragraph that keeps one bookmark and gains or loses another
symptom: compare refuses with "comparison cannot revise paragraph boundary structures at" a paragraph when two paragraphs it compares together hold different bookmarks and one of them is also held by the other version, for instance a heading that keeps its bookmark and gains a `_Toc` bookmark from a table of contents rebuilt in one version only, or a `_Ref` bookmark from a cross-reference added in Word (the paragraph the message names may be paired with another one)
workaround: compare the versions before rebuilding their tables of contents (Rust and Python `rebuild_toc`, CLI `oxoffice docx toc rebuild`), then rebuild the contents of the accepted result; for a bookmark added another way, compare that pair in Word or remove the extra bookmark from one version first
